result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make dehumanization impossible.

Not by removing pain, conflict, or disagreement—those would still exist. But I’d make it impossible for people to see others as less than human, as disposable, as enemies to be erased, or as groups whose suffering matters less.

A lot of the world’s worst suffering starts there. Wars, slavery, genocide, poverty ignored, cruelty normalized, people reduced to labels. If you could no longer convince yourself that someone else’s pain is “less real,” the world would still be messy and difficult, but it would be harder to justify doing monstrous things.
